Name: Tropical Forest Farm
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Tropical Island Farm for Stardew Valley 1.6.9+[/size][/b][/center]

[b][size=4]Hard Requirements:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10792]Alvadea's Tilesheets[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7996]Daisyniko's Tilesheets[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8131]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/url]
[/list]

[b][size=4]Optional Add-ons:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8716]Italian Countryside Farmhouse[/url] (featured in screenshots)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8866]Easy Farm Switcher[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9425]Custom Farm Loader[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
[/list]

[b][size=4]Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Two Versions of the Tropical Island Farm:[/b]
[list]
[*][u]Permanent Summer Version:[/u] Mimics Ginger Island's eternal summer climate with crops that won’t wither at the end of the month.
[*][u]Seasonal Mainland Version:[/u] A traditional farm layout that changes with the seasons while retaining the tropical island aesthetic.
[/list][*]Fully functional [b]beach foraging spots[/b] and [b]ocean fishing areas[/b].
[*][b]Unique starter furniture[/b] and decorations to match the tropical theme.
[*][b]Ginger Island-inspired forest ambience[/b] for immersive gameplay.
[*][b]Does not replace existing farms[/b]—this is an entirely new map option.
[*]Fully compatible with [b]Easy Farm Switcher[/b] and [b]Custom Farm Loader[/b] for easy setup and switching.
[/list]


[b][size=4]Important Notes:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]For users of [b]Easy Farm Switcher[/b] or seasonal graphics, remember to [b]save and restart your game[/b] to ensure all changes take effect.
[*] full compatibility with [b]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/b].
[/list]

[/list]
